role: Periodic decay and garbage collection of knowledge confidence in the World Knowledge Graph (WORLD instance) using ACT-R base-level activation principles.
detail: ConfidenceDecayService is an injectable NestJS service that implements IConfidenceDecayService, running a periodic decay cycle. The cycle has three stages: (1) decayNodes() applies time-based confidence reduction to all non-schema nodes using per-provenance decay rates (SENSOR=0.05, GUARDIAN=0.03, LLM_GENERATED=0.08, INFERENCE=0.06) with formula new_conf = max(0.0, old_conf - decayRate * ln(hoursSince+1)), reading from last_retrieval_at (set by reinforce edge), falling back to updated_at then created_at via coalesce(); (2) decayEdges() applies the same decay formula to edges (no last_retrieval_at support for edges yet); (3) pruneOrphanedNodes() deletes :Entity nodes with confidence <= PRUNE_THRESHOLD (0.10) that have no relationships, preserving structural nodes (Drive, CoBeing, ActionProcedure, Conversation, Insight, Word). The MIN_HOURS_BEFORE_DECAY threshold (1.0 hour) prevents freshly-touched nodes from decaying on the same cycle. Decay operates only on WORLD instance (WKG); OTHER instance (OKG) decay is deferred per stub §2.11. runDecayCycle() returns DecayCycleResult with counts and wasNoop flag.
gotchas: Edge decay does NOT yet read last_retrieval_at (noted WS3 T3: only nodes are reinforced by use→reinforce edge); OKG decay deferred to future gate-design (stub 2.11); toNumber() helper handles Neo4j Integer conversion; all queries guard against schema_level='schema' and structural labels; decay only applies where hoursSince > MIN_HOURS_BEFORE_DECAY; errors in any step log warning and return 0 but do not fail the cycle.
